title: The Product Options and Price Calculation Formulas for WooCommerce – Uni CPO plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to…
description: The WooCommerce Uni CPO plugin for WordPress versions up to and including 4.9.69 contains a stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability via the 'price_disabled_msg' setting. This vulnerability arises from improper handling of HTML entity decoding, allowing double-entity-encoded tags to bypass sanitization and be stored as live HTML. Authenticated users with Shop Manager-level access or higher can exploit this to inject malicious scripts that execute when users view the affected product pages.
